facts.text: We are not a herd, we are just eating together. Sid, stop licking the melons and pass them round.
facts.why: Manny does not say this in the film. Sid licking melons is invented, and the 'we are not a herd' line is stitched into a longer made-up speech.
facts.fix: Sid, hands off the melons. Pass them round, we are not a herd.

facts.text: Sid, lord of the flame, lit these.
facts.why: Sid declares 'refer to me as Sid, Lord of the Flame' after he makes fire, and Diego points out his tail is on fire.
